_comment_1: Provenance metadata for the vendored CTH v0.3 schema (sibling file inventory.schema.v0.3.json). See docs/cth/README.md §Refresh procedure for how to update both files in tandem.
_comment_2: JSON has no inline comment support, so this metadata lives in a sibling .meta.json file rather than as a header in the schema file itself. The CI workflow (.github/workflows/cth-schema-lint.yml) only reads the schema file; this meta file is purely informational for audit + refresh purposes.

Prior 0.3.2 sync: confluent-trust#98.

This is the load-bearing primitive the Toddle drift-check + Walk pin-by-reference key on (cth-qbp-live-testing seq 29-33). refresh_procedure: See docs/cth/README.md §Refresh procedure. On each refresh: (1) re-copy schema, (2) re-compute sha256 and update this file, (3) update vendored_on_date_utc, (4) update vendored_upstream_commit_sha, (5) verify .github/workflows/cth-schema-lint.yml still passes against current archive/cth-inventory/*.json, (6) update QBP PR number that performed the refresh.
